Title: Generally Available: Run load tests in debug mode on Azure Load Testing

Body.Content: Azure Load Testing now supports running low scale test runs in Debug mode enabling better debuggability with enhanced logging. It provides debug logs for the test script, and request and response data for every failed request during the test run. Debuggability of test scripts during load testing is crucial for identifying and resolving issues early in the testing process. It allows you to validate the test configuration, understand the application behavior under load, and troubleshoot any issues that arise. Learn more.
